notes.title: Kidnelis Update!
notes.content: More than 120 new phrases have been added with this update so all players can now enjoy new and fun statements. Will you answer them all of them right?

notes.title: Kidnelis Update!
notes.content:
We've added a game completion screen and made the sentence construction system more intuitive. 
Now users can also drag and drop the words instead of pressing multiple times.

We've also corrected the Font type selection: Cursive or Print which wasn’t portraying accurately the choice by default and optimized the order in which games are saved.

notes.title: Kidnelis Update!
notes.content:
What does this update include?

We have optimized the project files for storing the progress of each player without errors.

notes.title: Kidnelis Update!
notes.content:
What does this update include?

We have optimized the project so that the videogame files take up less space on your computer.

We've also implemented the STEAM’s Cloud Save feature so you can play using your profiles from any computer.

notes.title: Kidnelis Update!
notes.content:
What does this update include?

We've added a credits section to the main screen (clapperboard icon), to reflect who has contributed to what.

We've also included improvements to the optional drawing and writing activity such as:

 A smaller pointer for more precision when writing or drawing
 The eraser function for the drawing and writing panel
 A trash can icon to erase all content at once
 The green colour on the drawing panel

We've also considered the feedback received so far in the reviews to improve the experience for players by:

Including a description via an information icon in:
[olist]
 The configuration screen to explain what the optional activity consists of.
 The game screen (replicate the phrase) that allows the player to know what the objective of the game is in case of doubt.
[/olist]
The addition of changes to the “saved results” screen of the profile, to make it easier to understand each column.
